results.title: Monkey King: The Volcano
results.overview: Another chapter in the Journey to the West saga, this time Tang Sanzang and his disciples must attempt to cross Fiery Mountain.  But the region is controlled by demons led by the Bull King, and it seems that Sun Wukong’s own past may prove to be a bigger obstacle than the volcano blocking their way.

results.title: The Monkey King: The Legend Begins
results.original_title: The Monkey King: The Legend Begins
results.overview: The Monkey King: The Legend Begins is the re-imagined version by Hollywood of the film The Monkey King: Havoc in Heavens Palace, the origin and birthplace of The Monkey King Story.

results.title: Monkey King Looks West
results.overview: This colorful production contrasts the rich heritage of Chinese opera with the day-to-day realities of its emigréperformers in New York's Chinatown. It depicts the efforts of three classically-trained opera artists to keep alive their revered art form for the generation of young Chinese-Americans who would otherwise not be exposed to their tradition.In the time-worn pattern of immigrant life, they spend their days grinding out a living. In their spare time each performs and teaches Chinese opera. Scenes from the classic work Monkey King Looks West stand as a metaphor for cultural survival.

results.title: The Monkey King: Uproar in Heaven
results.overview: Sun Wukong, the King of the Monkeys, sets off on his first adventure to gain a worthy weapon. This earns the attention of the Jade Emperor of Heaven.

results.title: True and False Monkey King
results.original_title: 真假美猴王之大圣无双
results.overview: Ziteng was hurt by Wukong. To save her, Liu Er promised the Devil he would use Wukong’s identity and abort the pilgrimage. His fights against Wukong came to draws and nobody could tell who the right monkey was. Liu Er got lost in mind and believed he was Wukong. For the peace of the world, he had to fight side by side with Wukong even at the price of his life.

results.title: The Real Monkey King: Bufashan
results.overview: At the mysterious Bufa Mountain inn where no one can use magic, strangers; some from the Western Regions converge with hidden motives. A Journey to the West-style “werewolf game” unfolds as even the monk’s party hides their identities.

results.title: Monkey King Fight Lion Camel
results.overview: As Tang Sanzang and his disciples arrive at Lion Camel Ridge, they encounter villagers captured by demons. Wukong's attempt to rescue them goes awry, and he and Zhu Bajie fall into a trap set by the three demon kings. Overwhelmed by their enemies, Wukong seeks help from the Buddha and learns the value of unity and teamwork. With the help of his brothers and a Bodhisattva, they work together to save the villagers and continue their journey westward, stronger and more united than before.

results.title: Seeking the Monkey King
results.overview: Suggestion: Please see 'Another Occupation' before 'Seeking the Monkey King'. Contains flicker like many of my works; avoid if you have epilepsy or other unusual brain conditions.

results.title: The Westward: Good Bye, Monkey King
results.overview: Prequel to animation series "Journey to the West", Su Yi, a princess of the heavenly realm, befriends Sun Wukong in the mortal world and falls in love with him. However, Sun Wukong is violently treated as a demon by other gods and suppressed under the Five Fingers Mountain. In the past 300 years, the god Rulai has taught the Wukong how to uphold justice in his heart. Sun Wukong protects the Longevity Monk and goes to the other side of the world to retrieve the fire of creation for the benefit of the world, but finally returns after many ups and downs. The conspiracy surfaced and the fate of the master and disciples was rewritten.

results.title: The Monkey King Conquers the Leopard
The Monkey King Conquers Monsters
results.overview: Based on the chapter of Fire Cloud Cave, the movie tells the story of Red Child, who is naughty by nature and innocent at heart, being compelled by the Black Cloud Immortal to capture the Longevity Monk to make a reunion dinner for his parents. During the fight between Wukong and Red Child, Black Cloud Immortal takes the opportunity to take advantage of the situation and awakens the ancient demonic beast Taotie. Black Cloud Immortal manipulates Taotie to attack the Heavenly Court and the Spirit Mountain, stirring up the three worlds, and eventually, Wukong uses self-sacrifice to resolve the disaster, and at the same time, awakens the goodness in Red Child's heart.

results.title: The Monkey King 3D: Uproar in Heaven
results.overview: A completely remade animation film based on the original 1961 animation The Monkey King. Mythical ancient China. Born from some magic stones that fell to Earth a long time ago when Goddess Nüwa mended the sky, Sun Wukong, aka Monkey King, sets off on his first adventure to gain a worthy weapon. This earns the attention of the Jade Emperor of Heaven.

results.title: Monkey King: The One and Only
results.overview: During their journey to the west to retrieve Buddhist sutras, Sun Wukong is always questioned by his master Tang Sanzang about killing people indiscriminately, which results in a gap between them. One day, they stray into a village and run into a cute fox Xiaoqi, and Xiaoqi's elder brother is onto Tang Sanzang and his three disciples in order to extend Xiaoqi's life...

results.title: Shimmy: The First Monkey King
results.original_title: 超级英雄美猴王：齐天儿
results.overview: Shimmy, a monkey newly discover superhero powers and learns how to control his extraordinary transformative abilities and prevent powerful demonic forces from sending the universe into chaos.

results.title: The Birth of the Monkey King
Adventures of the Monkey King
results.original_title: 孫悟空が始まるよー　黄風大王の巻
results.overview: This is a pilot film for an animated TV program based on "Son-goku the Monkey." In order to get an idea of the reaction of children, its main audience, a preview was held at an elementary school. It received complaints that Son-goku was portrayed too nicely.
